purpose: A deterministic setup guide. This catalog does not connect, bill, or provision provider accounts.
budget_note: Your monthly amount is a ceiling, not a promise of a fixed bill. Core Jarvis features do not need a paid AI plan. Hardware, internet, and electricity are separate.

providers.name: Jarvis local features
providers.description: Dashboard, simulated practice, local presence policy, optional Windows actions, and explicit permission controls.

providers.name: Vosk offline command listening
providers.description: Recognizes supported command phrases on your computer after installing the optional packages and a local language model. It is not a speaking voice.

providers.name: A local voice already on your device
providers.description: Optional spoken setup guidance can use a browser voice marked as local. Availability depends on your browser and operating system. Text guidance always remains available.
requires: A browser with an installed local speech voice

providers.name: Ollama with a local model
providers.description: A possible future local AI component. Jarvis does not currently route questions to it. Model memory requirements vary. Ollama also offers cloud models, so a local address alone does not establish offline processing.
requires: A model suitable for your hardware

providers.name: OpenAI API
providers.description: Optional future cloud integration with usage-based charges. No API key is requested by this setup page and no OpenAI connection is implemented here.
providers.credit_note: Eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can claim API credits by linking an API organization they own. Benefits require activation and eligibility checks; a chat subscription is not an automatic Jarvis connection.
requires: Your own API organization and project
Your own billing or eligible credits

providers.name: Claude API
providers.description: Optional future cloud integration using your own Claude Console access. This page does not collect a key or connect Jarvis to the API.
providers.credit_note: Claude subscription and Console access are separate. Some Max and Team plans include monthly API credits; check and activate your current benefit in the provider console.
requires: Your own billing or eligible credits

providers.name: ElevenLabs API voice
providers.description: Optional future generated speech. Jarvis does not currently send text or audio to ElevenLabs. Voice choice and estimated monthly use affect cost.
requires: Review of the provider's current terms
